findings.title: No optimistic-locking guard on delete
findings.description: deleteCompanyByIdAndState deletes on ID and COMPANY_STATE only; a stale caller can remove a row that changed after it was read. Confirmed statically from the mapper source; the surrounding application's concurrency behavior is unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add a version or last-updated-timestamp predicate to the WHERE clause if concurrent modification of COMPANY rows is possible.

findings.title: Affected-row count not enforced
findings.description: The mapper returns the native affected-row count but the statement cannot guarantee exactly one row was deleted.
findings.recommendation: Have the caller verify the returned affected-row count equals 1 and treat any other value as a failure.
